title: IT In-Charge
description:
**Job Title:**
IT In-Charge
  
  
**Location:**
Gurukulam Global Residential School, Arasakuppam, Denkanikottai, Krishnagiri (Dt), Tamil Nadu
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a reliable and technically proficient IT In-Charge to manage and maintain the entire IT infrastructure, digital learning systems, and campus network at Gurukulam Global Residential School. The ideal candidate will ensure uninterrupted technology operations across classrooms, computer labs, hostels, and administrative offices while supporting students and staff with day-to-day technical needs.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**IT Infrastructure & Hardware Maintenance:**
Manage, configure, and maintain desktop computers, laptops, smart boards, projectors, printers, biometric devices, and other campus hardware.
  
  
Oversee the functioning and upkeep of school computer labs to ensure smooth practical sessions for students.
  
  
Perform routine preventive maintenance, system upgrades, and timely troubleshooting to minimize equipment downtime.
  
  
**Network, Security & Campus Systems**
Administer and monitor campus-wide LAN, Wi-Fi networks, internet connectivity, routers, switches, and servers.
  
  
Oversee campus CCTV surveillance systems, PA systems, and access control infrastructure in coordination with the security and facilities teams.
  
  
Ensure data security, regular system backups, antivirus updates, and safe internet usage policies across the campus.
  
  
**Software, ERP & Technical Support**
Provide prompt first-level technical support to teachers, administrative staff, and students during classes, exams, and school events.
  
  
Manage school ERP/LMS portals, official email accounts, software licenses, and online assessment setups.
  
  
Assist with audio-visual and live-streaming setups for assemblies, workshops, parent meetings, and annual functions.
  
  
**Inventory & Vendor Coordination**
Maintain an accurate inventory of all IT hardware, software licenses, peripherals, and consumables.
  
  
Coordinate with external IT vendors, internet service providers, and AMC partners for repairs, procurements, and service renewals.
  
  
**Qualifications & Requirements**
BCA / B.Sc. Computer Science / B.Tech / MCA or any relevant IT degree.
  
  
2–5 years of hands-on experience in IT administration, hardware/networking, or school IT management.
  
  
Strong working knowledge of Windows/Linux OS, LAN/Wi-Fi networking, CCTV systems, smart classrooms, and basic ERP administration.
  
  
Good communication, problem-solving, and documentation skills, with the ability to work independently in a residential campus environment.
  
  
**Compensation & Benefits**
**Salary:**
Based on skillset, experience, and communication.
  
  
**Accommodation:**
Group accommodation provided for outstation candidates.

Interested candidates can send their updated resume to
**Hr@gurukulamschools.com**
or contact
**8870004592**

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
**Description**
At Gigamon, our purpose is to protect the hybrid networks and data of the largest, most complex organizations on the planet. Certified as a Great Place to Work, we offer a deep observability pipeline that efficiently delivers network-derived intelligence to cloud,
  
  
security, and observability tools. This helps our customers to eliminate security blind spots, optimize network traffic, and dramatically reduce tool cost and complexity, enabling them to better secure and manage their hybrid cloud infrastructure. Gigamon
  
  
has served more than 4,000 customers worldwide, including over 80 percent of Fortune 100 enterprises, 9 of the 10 largest mobile network providers, and hundreds of
  
  
governments and educational organizations.
  
  
The Sr. Support Engineer (I.C.) provides advanced technical support to customers using Gigamon solutions. This role troubleshoots complex networking issues across Layer 2 and Layer 3 technologies, manages escalations through resolution, and partners with internal teams to address customer concerns. The engineer also supports RMA
  
  
coordination, issue documentation, and customer satisfaction analysis. Success in this role requires strong technical depth, effective cross-functional collaboration, and a
  
  
customer-focused approach to problem resolution.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Provide advanced technical support to assigned customers through phone and email support queues.
* Troubleshoot, reproduce, and develop workarounds for complex product and networking issues.

* Earned a bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical field.
* Gained at least three years of technical service or technical support experience in networking.
* Built strong working knowledge across Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking technologies.
* Demonstrated experience troubleshooting customer issues, reproducing problems, and developing effective workarounds.
* Managed technical escalations and coordinated complex issues across multiple internal teams.
* Worked directly with customers to resolve technical issues and improve customer satisfaction.
* Developed strong project management, problem-solving, and analytical skills.

* An active listener who builds productive relationships with customers and cross-functional teams.

title: Specialist NPO
description:
**Job Description**
As a Network Performance Optimization (NPO) Specialist, you will monitor and analyze network performance, identify and diagnose root causes of issues, and implement optimization actions such as QoS adjustments, parameter tuning, and software upgrades to ensure continuous performance.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**

* Lead and serve as the primary contact for specific technical domains and Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), managing project deliverables independently.
* Engage with customers as a Subject Matter Expert (SME), offering technical guidance and insights.
* Optimize network performance through traffic, capacity, and neighbor management to enhance Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and end-user experience.
* Identify and recommend new feature rollouts and conduct carrier aggregation analysis for multi-carrier networks.
* Perform analysis and optimization for benchmarking activities (e.g., Umlaut/P3, regulatory drive tests) and validate/optimize Network Performance Optimization (NPO) tools.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., CM, PM, FM, OMS) to resolve issues and manage customer interactions regarding Service Level Agreement (SLA) KPIs, regulatory compliance, and benchmarking reports.

**Key Skills And Experience**
**You Have:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in or related field with experience in Network Performance Optimization.
* Expertise in radio optimization for the latest SW/HW Release of Nokia 5G/4G and/or Samsung/Huawei 5G /4G Network.
* Experience in OEM-specific tools and products, including Nokia SRAN BTS, NetAct, and/or Samsung LSMR, USM.
* Experience in at least two RATs (5G & 4G) per OEM.
* End-to-end correlation across Radio, Access, IP, Transport, and Core domains.to improve Customer Experience, Service KPIs.
* Experience in spectrum refarming, 2G/3G sunset strategies, and post-optimization activities. Proficiency in data visualization & reporting tools (PowerPoint, Excel, Pivot Tables, Power BI).
* Experience in Radio Network Consolidation, ORAN, Cloud RAN, VRAN, Enterprise Networks, Private 5G, Massive MIMO, Network Slicing, MEC, and IoT Connectivity.

**It would be nice if you also had:**

* Experience in network deployment, backhaul delivery, or telecom operations
* Familiarity with PO processes, documentation approvals, and compliance workflows

title: Jr. System Administrator
description:
**About The Role**
SDS is seeking a skilled Systems Engineer with strong experience in virtualization, Linux/Unix, and infrastructure engineering. This role requires working fully in the US shift (CT Time).
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, deploy, and manage virtualized environments (VMware/Hyper-V).
* Set up, configure, and maintain Linux/Unix servers including Davian-based systems.
* Administer MySQL databases at a basic to intermediate level.
* Implement and manage automation tools such as Puppet.
* Support GitLab (repositories, permissions, runners, and pipelines).
* Deploy new servers and configure firewalls and network rules.
* Collaborate with development and DevOps teams to support CI/CD and automation efforts.
* Document processes, maintain system standards, and implement improvements.

description:

All activities that consider both the business and the technical needs of the customers with the goal of providing a quality product that meets the users needs. The discipline that executes a robust process of design, creation, and optimization of systems, consisting of identification and quantification of system requirements, creation of alternate system design concepts, performance of design trade studies, selection and implementation of the best designs and verification that the design is properly integrated and executed. Process that proceeds from concept to production to operation.
  
  
Accountable for the quality of own work. Subject to direct operations supervision/prescribed work instructions/systems checking. Executes within a well-defined operations framework. To have knowledge on Integration of IEDs of different OEMs with IEC61850

This role requires basic experience in the Site Commissioning, Engineering/Technology & Controls Engineering. Knowledge level is comparable to a Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college ( or a high school diploma with relevant experience).
  
  
3 to 5 years of Experience with Relevant commissioning experience.
